actions.name: Fade
actions.description: As a full action, the mech initiates active camouflage, granting it concealment until it makes an attack or performs other harmful actions. If the mech begins combat while this ability is active, it begins the encounter with 1 less PP (minimum 1).

actions.name: Cloak
actions.description: As a standard action, the mech fades from view as per invisibility. The effect lasts for 1 round, though the mech can extend the duration each round by expending 1 PP. The effect ends if the mech makes an attack or performs other harmful actions.

description.value:
Prerequisite: Must have recon frame.

Light-warping and sound-dampening mechanisms enhance the mech's stealth capabilities.

@PPAbility[cost:0]{Fade} Gain concealment until you make an attack or take a harmful action.

@PPAbility[cost:4]{Cloak} Become invisible for 1 round. You can extend the duration by spending 1 PP per additional round.
